notes.TWN: 民法第 985 條：有配偶者，不得重複結婚；重婚依刑法第 237 條處罰
notes.NGA: 條目同時列在「承認」與「只依習慣法承認」：習慣法的婚姻可以多偶，北部實施伊斯蘭法的各州也承認；依法登記的婚姻不行
notes.IND: 穆斯林依穆斯林屬人法可以多偶；條目另寫果阿依當地的習慣法
notes.ZAF: 依習慣法締結的婚姻承認多偶，最高法院也承認依伊斯蘭法締結的婚姻
notes.PHL: 只有穆斯林，而且限於能平等對待每位妻子的「例外情形」
notes.IRQ: 伊拉克庫德斯坦地區除外
notes.SYR: 敘利亞庫德斯坦（東北部）除外
notes.KAZ: 不承認多偶婚，但 1998 年起不處罰
notes.RUS: 不承認多偶婚（家庭法典），但重婚不處罰
notes.HKG: 1971 年起廢除；之前依習慣法締結的婚姻在某些情形仍承認
notes.MYT: 法屬馬約特：2009 年公投後適用法國法律，之前已締結的多偶婚仍有效
notes.GBR: 在國外依法締結的多偶婚可以領部分福利（逐步取消中）；在英國再婚是重婚罪
notes.NZL: 不能在國內締結，但承認在允許多偶的國家依法締結的婚姻
notes.CHE: 在國外締結的多偶婚依個案承認或不承認
notes.AUS: 不能在國內締結；部分原住民社群仍有多偶關係

notesEn.TWN: Civil Code Article 985 prohibits a married person from marrying again; bigamy is punishable under Article 237 of the Criminal Code
notesEn.NGA: Listed under both “recognized” and “customary law only”: customary marriages may be polygamous, and the northern Sharia states also recognize it; statutory marriages may not
notesEn.IND: Muslims may take more than one wife under Muslim personal law; the article also notes customary law in Goa
notesEn.ZAF: Polygamy is recognized for customary marriages, and the Supreme Court has held Muslim marriages valid
notesEn.PHL: Muslims only, and only in “exceptional cases” where a man can treat his wives equally
notesEn.KAZ: Polygamous marriages are not recognized, but the practice has not been a crime since 1998
notesEn.RUS: Polygamous marriages are not recognized (Family Code), but bigamy is not a crime
notesEn.HKG: Abolished in 1971; earlier customary unions are still recognized in some situations
notesEn.MYT: French Mayotte: French law has applied since the 2009 referendum; pre-existing polygamous marriages remain valid
notesEn.GBR: Foreign polygamous marriages grant some welfare benefits (being phased out); marrying again in the UK is bigamy
notesEn.NZL: Polygamous marriages cannot be performed in New Zealand but are recognized if lawfully contracted abroad
notesEn.CHE: Polygamous marriages contracted abroad may be accepted or rejected case by case
notesEn.AUS: Polygamous marriages cannot be performed in Australia; polygamous relationships persist in some Indigenous communities
